config.label: solution-service base URL used for startup auto-registration
config.description: solution-service base URL used for startup auto-registration. Defaults to https://console.tengence.com.

config.label: Search API key (app-level, sk-) for the /v1/search endpoint
config.description: Search API key (app-level, sk-) for the /v1/search endpoint. Optional: search_init auto-provisions and stores it locally (state.json).

config.label: Dataset API key (sk-) for the /v1/push/data endpoint
config.description: Dataset API key (sk-) for the /v1/push/data endpoint.

config.label: siteUrl used as the idempotency match key during registration
config.description: siteUrl used as the idempotency match key during registration. Defaults to https://tengence-mcp.local/<deviceId>.

config.label: Override for the search API base
config.description: Override for the search API base. Defaults to https://api.tengence.com.

config.label: Override for the push API base
config.description: Override for the push API base. Defaults to https://api.mossego.com.

config.label: Internal runtime data directory holding state
config.description: Internal runtime data directory holding state.json (device identity + registration credentials). Defaults to ~/.tengence/search-mcp.
